rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_DLL
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects common characteristics of Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs"
        author = "SOC Team"
        last_modified = "2026-04-09"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2E 72 63 64 72 00 } // ".rcdr" string common in beacons
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and // MZ header
        filesize < 500KB and
        all of ($beacon_config, $http_get, $user_agent)
}
